entities.name: Mastercard
entities.description: Brand and merchant advertiser activating sponsored, programmatic, and LLM-native video ads across iHeart destinations via Genuin's infrastructure.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Web destination publisher where the Genuin SDK is embedded and Mastercard advertising is delivered to end users.

entities.name: LiveRamp
entities.description: Recommended identity resolution partner that maps Genuin's pseudonymous user identifiers to Mastercard's user graph for audience targeting and closed-loop measurement.

entities.name: Aniview
entities.description: Third-party ad server that fulfils programmatic in-feed and in-stream placements via VAST/VMAP, PMP/PG deals, or oRTB bidding.

entities.name: Koah
entities.description: Partner that powers LLM-native conversational ad delivery within the Genuin AI overlay and provides four supported ad formats.

entities.name: OctoGPT
entities.description: AI-powered conversational overlay embedded on top of the Genuin video feed; triggered by configurable dwell to surface contextual prompts and ad units.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Client SDK embedded on iHeart's web destination that requests the video feed, resolves identity at targeting time, and renders the video carousel with ad slots.

entities.name: Genuin Video Infrastructure
entities.description: Backend that hosts and serves uploaded brand video creatives for Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post placements.

entities.name: Genuin BCC
entities.description: Brand Control Center used to upload direct-sold sponsored video content and access out-of-the-box performance metrics for all placements.

entities.name: Genuin Pixel
entities.description: Lightweight JavaScript tag placed on Mastercard merchant pages that enables post-exposure conversion attribution and closed-loop reporting.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Highest-impact direct-sold in-feed placement that converts the first N slots of the feed into a continuous Mastercard-sponsored experience.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Direct-sold in-feed card containing Mastercard branded video served at calculated frequency-based slot positions interleaved with organic content.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Video
entities.description: Programmatic video ad served as a feed card via Google IMA SDK and Aniview, with a CTA bar replacing standard engagement icons.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Native
entities.description: Programmatic native card creative (headline, image, brand, description, CTA) rendered via GPT.js and fulfilled by Aniview.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Display
entities.description: Programmatic standard banner (image or HTML5) rendered as a full feed card slot via GPT.js and Aniview.

entities.name: In-Stream Ad
entities.description: Linear video ads that play before, during, or after organic content videos within the Genuin video carousel player via VAST/VMAP.

entities.name: LLM Ads
entities.description: Native conversational ad placements served within Genuin's AI-powered chat overlay, activated through the partnership with Koah.

entities.name: Action Card
entities.description: Koah card-format ad unit with configurable CTA buttons and destination URL designed to drive direct user action from within the conversation.

entities.name: Image Card
entities.description: Koah visually-led card ad featuring a brand image, headline, and optional description, suited for awareness and visual storytelling.

entities.name: Poll
entities.description: Koah interactive poll embedded in the LLM conversation, with pre-defined options that inform audience insight and engagement measurement.

entities.name: Expandable
entities.description: Koah compact teaser unit that expands to reveal full ad content on user tap, allowing richer creative without disrupting conversation flow.

entities.name: BYOA
entities.description: Sponsored content targeting option where Mastercard's own algorithm returns valid Genuin video_id values for per-user creative selection at serve time.

entities.name: Catalog API
entities.description: Endpoint that syncs Mastercard's CMS with Genuin's video infrastructure so the BYOA algorithm can return valid video_id references.

entities.name: Context Attribution
entities.description: Measurement capability that tracks the video content consumed immediately before a sponsored placement to link pre-exposure content journeys to conversions.

entities.name: Google IMA SDK
entities.description: Google rendering SDK used to deliver programmatic in-feed video creatives from Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.

entities.name: GPT.js
entities.description: Google Publisher Tag library used to render programmatic in-feed native and display creatives via Aniview.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: Video ad serving template standard (versions 2.0, 3.0, 4.0) used for programmatic video creative delivery and click tracking.

entities.name: VMAP
entities.description: Video multiple ad playlist standard supporting one ad per pre/mid/post-roll break within the in-stream Genuin player.

entities.name: oRTB
entities.description: Real-time bidding protocol enabling Mastercard's DSP to plug directly into Aniview and respond to bid requests for iHeart inventory.

entities.name: PMP
entities.description: Private Marketplace deal type created in Mastercard's DSP and accepted by Aniview for negotiated CPM access to iHeart inventory.

entities.name: Programmatic Guaranteed
entities.description: Guaranteed-delivery deal type that secures a fixed allocation of iHeart inventory at a negotiated CPM while maintaining DSP workflow.

entities.name: ID5
entities.description: Open, privacy-first identity solution offered as an alternative identity partner with strong cookieless reach on web inventory.

entities.name: UID 2.0
entities.description: Email-based pseudonymous ID maintained by The Trade Desk, widely adopted across programmatic supply chains.

entities.name: The Trade Desk
entities.description: Programmatic platform company that maintains the UID 2.0 identity standard.

entities.name: Lotame
entities.description: Data collaboration platform offered as an alternative identity partner with cross-device graph capabilities.

entities.name: Epsilon
entities.description: First-party data network offered as an alternative identity partner with strong retail and commerce media applications.

relationships.description: Mastercard activates brand and merchant advertising across iHeart destinations under the sponsorship described in this guide.
Mastercard's identity graph is mapped to Genuin's user graph via LiveRamp for audience targeting and closed-loop measurement.
Mastercard delivers LLM-native conversational ads through the joint Genuin/Koah activation managed via Koah's portal.
Mastercard places the Genuin Pixel JavaScript tag on merchant and conversion destination pages to enable post-exposure attribution.
Mastercard can opt into the Bring Your Own Algorithm path to control per-user creative selection for Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post.
Mastercard uploads direct-sold sponsored video content and reviews out-of-the-box performance metrics via the Genuin BCC dashboard.
The Genuin SDK is embedded on iHeart's web destination and loads on page load to request the targeted video feed.
The SDK requests assembled video posts and ad slots from the Genuin backend video infrastructure for rendering in the carousel.
Sponsored Takeover places Mastercard-uploaded video into the first N feed slots served by Genuin's video infrastructure.
Sponsored Post serves Mastercard-branded video at frequency-based slot positions from Genuin's video infrastructure.
Sponsored Takeover is a direct-sold placement with content uploaded via the Genuin Brand Control Center.
Sponsored Post is a direct-sold placement with content uploaded via the Genuin Brand Control Center.
Sponsored Takeover supports BYOA as an optional targeting path alongside the out-of-the-box targeting option.
Sponsored Post supports BYOA as an optional targeting path alongside the out-of-the-box targeting option.
Programmatic in-feed video creatives are fulfilled by the Aniview ad server in real time.
Programmatic in-feed video uses Google's IMA SDK as the rendering layer for DSP-served creatives.
Programmatic in-feed video supports VAST 2.0, 3.0, and 4.0 request formats with optional VPAID JS.
Programmatic in-feed native creatives are fulfilled by Aniview via GPT.js rendering.
Programmatic in-feed native uses Google Publisher Tag (GPT.js) as the rendering SDK.
Programmatic in-feed display banners are fulfilled by Aniview.
Programmatic in-feed display banners are rendered via Google Publisher Tag (GPT.js).
In-stream linear video ads run programmatically through the Aniview ad server.
In-stream placements support VAST 2.0/3.0/4.0 with optional VPAID JS creatives.
In-stream placements support VMAP with one ad per pre/mid/post-roll break; ad podding is not supported.
Programmatic in-feed video can be transacted via DSP oRTB bidding integration path with Aniview.
In-stream placements can be transacted via DSP oRTB bidding integration path with Aniview.
Aniview accepts PMP deal IDs created in Mastercard's DSP as the recommended programmatic integration path.
Aniview accepts Programmatic Guaranteed deal IDs as the recommended path for guaranteed delivery and fixed pricing.
Koah selects and serves LLM ad units within the Octo GPT conversation overlay in real time.
The Octo GPT AI overlay is the surface within which LLM ad units are rendered and contextualised to the conversation.
Action Card is one of four Koah ad formats available within the LLM conversation overlay.
Image Card is one of four Koah ad formats available within the LLM conversation overlay.
Poll is one of four Koah ad formats available within the LLM conversation overlay.
Expandable is one of four Koah ad formats available within the LLM conversation overlay.
Audience-targeted LLM placements pass Mastercard identity segments resolved via LiveRamp to Koah for targeting within the overlay.
BYOA requires the Catalog API video ID sync so Mastercard's algorithm can return valid Genuin video_id values in its response.
UID 2.0 is the email-based pseudonymous identity standard maintained by The Trade Desk.
ID5 is offered as an alternative identity partner to LiveRamp for resolution against iHeart inventory.
UID 2.0 is offered as an alternative identity standard to LiveRamp for programmatic identity resolution.
Lotame is offered as an alternative identity partner to LiveRamp with cross-device graph capabilities.
Epsilon is offered as an alternative identity partner to LiveRamp with retail and commerce media applications.
Genuin's measurement stack pairs Pixel-based post-exposure attribution with Context Attribution for pre-exposure content journey insight.
Mastercard's DSP integrates with Aniview via VAST tags, PMP/PG deal IDs, or oRTB bidding to serve programmatic creatives.
